owner_requirement: Mechanism of Action per drug and proposed condition; universal sidebar label Mechanisms, rooted in source evidence; ingestion must collect the fields.
scope: Prospective contract and coverage preparation only. No new acquisition, source extraction, import, web, dispatch, site or canonical edits.

base_future_acquisition.meaning: Current future acquisition-only plan is preserved; integrate this addendum into a new explicitly versioned operation before next affected request/extraction.

historical_return_contract.meaning: Actual Worker B and F00 Worker A subset retain their recorded dispatch contract; no retrofit failure for absent new mechanism fields.

schema.scope: Source-reported candidate intake with pending verification/pending human review/draft publication; downstream release requires separate accepted scientific and exact-version review contracts.

coverage.owner_required: D07 itraconazole by exact cancer condition; no umbrella-cancer extrapolation

units: Each source-reported mechanism assertion is scoped to a drug, original/proposed use, exact model/population, exposure and comparator where reported; measured markers are not clinical outcomes.
mapping: source/version -> exact locator -> mechanism claim/number -> original-use or drug-condition mechanism record -> Mechanism of Action section plus matching review Q03/Q05/Q09/Q10/Q13/Q14/Q15. Keep clinical result/synthesis links separate.
states: not_extracted, not_reported after full-source inspection, not_accessible, not_applicable, not_checked, not_identifiable, conflicting remain distinct. Every real source stays pending/pending/draft until separate acceptance.
calibration: Before later scaling, assign a varied source set containing human mechanistic work, animal/cell, computational prediction, secondary rationale and a null/contradictory or quarantined example if actually available. No invented source quota or fabricated specimen.
verification: Schema plus semantic validator; exact IDs, file and source hashes, per-claim and per-number locator references, tier/basis consistency, full-source-only not_reported, counterevidence, no efficacy/clinical-count promotion, quarantine and unchanged historical input checks. Visual table/figure checks during later authorized extraction, not this contract task.
resume: Reuse existing stable source/report/family IDs and accepted claims. New mechanism IDs additive, deterministic from source hash and scoped extraction identity; unchanged input must create zero new records. Never re-run completed ingest merely to populate new fields.
next_operation_prerequisites: Root adopts a dated prospective operation plan linking exact addendum/schema/coverage hashes; no extra owner confirmation is introduced.
Receipt and exact-file assignments use each actual return governing contract; reconcile latest inventory and preserve quarantines.
Create bounded extraction patch from permitted source versions, reusing accepted facts first; distinguish missing extraction from absent reporting.
